evidence: Authored for this product: instruction.md:1 describes a specific personal workflow ('paste a long one-line experiment, format it, make changes in several places, and then run it beside the source ... without losing a draft when another tab saves first'), and every public note is about a JS/HTML playground (overview.md: filename chooses execution mode; behaviour.md: fresh isolated preview, five-second budget, last-good picture, Stop, superseding runs; security.md: preview boundary and refused dynamic evaluation; ui.md: token colouring and Format document). All five dimension prompts and tests/app_context.md:3-6 name 'Colderwater playground'; a grep of the frozen task for other product names (patchpad, gridforge, boardloom, hireops, bazaar, medcare, torquebay, docketlight, expenseflow, pixeldeck, threadline) found none, and seed_data.json is task-specific (empty snippets list with a playground note). task.toml:5-15 gives a unique name and arena_slice 'custom-code-editor-formatting-preview-history' that no other projects/*/task.toml uses. Closest sibling is patchpad-editor-v3 (arena_slice 'full-stack-node-express-sqlite-custom-editor', an incident-report prose editor with a seeded document). Concept overlap exists on the custom-editor core: roughly 13 of Colderwater's 42 functional criteria share a concept with a PatchPad criterion (line join, grapheme handling, mouse selection, block indent, multi-caret typing and delete, find wrap, replace-all atomicity, save/restart, stale save, history restore). The other 29 or so have no PatchPad counterpart: 14 run/preview/runtime criteria (functional judge.toml:213-336, e.g. cw_basic_run_output, cw_promise_rejection_message_and_line, cw_last_good_recovery, cw_stop_cancels_pending_work, cw_newer_run_supersedes, cw_preview_isolation, cw_dynamic_code_refused), two colouring and three formatting criteria (judge.toml:168-210), three live-library criteria (judge.toml:375-399), plus same-line carets, undo-restores-caret, self-containing replace, caret-in-view, long-line editing, stale-save-keeps-draft and the restore-retry clause. PatchPad in turn has flows Colderwater lacks (seed integrity, word-navigation shortcuts, manifest routes, direct-API save matrix, no-op save invariant). Wording is not copied: 7-word-shingle overlap between Colderwater's public prose plus all criteria and PatchPad v3's is 48 of 10,604 shingles, and nearly all of those are shared judge.toml boilerplate (playwright MCP args, type/weight lines); the only prose phrases in common are generic ('ready made editor', 'at the start of the next line'). Overlap with gridforge-spreadsheet-v3 (33) and boardloom-infinite-canvas (25) is boilerplate only. Plausible-clone test: renaming PatchPad's entities could not yield this task, because two thirds of the graded outcomes concern code execution, isolation, formatting and syntax colouring that an incident-report editor does not have; conversely a conforming Colderwater app is not graded on any PatchPad-only flow. Limitation: no standalone suite domain-plan document exists in the frozen rules or workspace notes, so 'fits the domain plan' was judged, as quality-checks.md:213 directs, against sibling task names, arena slices and concepts; the task occupies a devtools/code-playground slot no sibling fills. This row is a source judgement; no run exercises it.
